content_sections.heading: About BBCI
content_sections.text: Dr. Bhubaneswar Borooah Cancer Institute (BBCI) is a cancer institute at Gopinath Nagar, Guwahati-781016, under Tata Memorial Centre (TMC), Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India. These project posts are for its "Pediatric and Adult Haematolymphoid Unit", and all selected candidates will be posted at Dr. B Borooah Cancer Institute, Guwahati.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: BBCI has advertised 9 posts in total across four positions. The notice does not give a category-wise (reservation) break-up.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Each post has its own qualification. The postgraduate degrees must be recognized by the National Medical Commission, as printed for each post below. For Consultant ‘E’ (Pathology), the notice gives two alternative routes: a D.M. in Oncopathology or Haematopathology, or an M.D. / D.N.B. (Pathology) or equivalent with at least 3 years of post M.D. / D.N.B. experience in Pathology. The 3-year experience condition is attached to the M.D. / D.N.B. route. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: All four posts carry a consolidated salary that rises with the candidate's years of experience. The notice does not mention any allowance on top of the consolidated salary, and it does not mention the in-hand salary. The position is temporary and purely on contractual basis. The appointment shall initially be for a period of six (06) months, which may be extended further solely on the basis of satisfactory performance, and shall remain co-terminus with the project. The candidate shall have no right or claim for permanent employment under the project or at BBCI, nor any right to claim continuation of services in any other project or position. The selection will not be an employment on Dr. B Borooah Cancer Institute's permanent pay-roll. Place of posting: Dr. B Borooah Cancer Institute, Guwahati.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications will be initially screened, and eligible candidates will be called for Interview / Written examination. The notice also refers to an MCQ / Skill Test / VIVA. The Institute reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates called for the Written Examination / Interview / Skill test to a reasonable limit, on the basis of the qualifications and experience of the applicants. It may also fix a minimum eligibility standard / bench mark and cut-off marks (Group / Stream / Discipline / Category-wise etc.), taking into account factors such as the number of vacancies and percentage of marks in Graduate / Post Graduate degrees. Merely fulfilling the prescribed qualifications does not entitle an applicant to be called. The decision of the Director, Dr. B Borooah Cancer Institute in this regard shall be final and binding. The list of shortlisted candidates for the MCQ / Skill Test / VIVA will be uploaded on the official website of Dr. B Borooah Cancer Institute. Information on the date of the interview / written examination will be sent by email to eligible candidates only. The notice does not give an exam pattern or an interview date.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BBCI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the online application link given in the notice: https://tmc.gov.in/fta/frm_Registration.aspx (candidates must apply through "Online Application" only). Apply for the chosen post in the prescribed format, giving full details of qualifications and experience, as these will be checked against original documents later. Provide a valid email ID, because all correspondence will be done through email only. Complete and submit the online application by 15 November 2026, up to 05:30 p.m. (Indian Standard Time). Incomplete and online non-submitted applications will be summarily rejected. Watch your email (including spam / bulk folders) and the BBCI website for the shortlist and the interview / written examination date. For further enquiry, candidates can email [email protected] . This address is for enquiries only, not for sending applications.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Candidates called for the Interview / Written Examination / Skill Test must carry original documents along with one set of copies supporting the details given in the online application, failing which they will not be allowed to appear. Identity proof (i.e. Aadhaar, PAN & Voter) Date of Birth: Birth Certificate / School leaving certificate / S.S.C passing certificate Educational Qualification: Mark sheet & Passing Certificate of final examination Experience Certificates – Current Employment: Appointment letter, Last month's Pay Slip and NOC Original testimonials for qualifications and experience, with one set of copies

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Accommodation will not be provided to outstation candidates. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. If a candidate does not fulfil the eligibility criteria or has furnished incorrect / false / incomplete information or suppressed any material fact, the candidature will be cancelled; if detected after appointment, services are liable to be terminated forthwith. The Institute reserves the right not to call any candidate for the written examination / Interview / Skill test without assigning any reason. The Institute does not take responsibility for non-receipt of online applications, or for emails lost because of an invalid / wrong email ID or delivery to spam / bulk mail folders. Candidates are responsible for receiving, downloading and printing related documents sent by email. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are in BBCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 9 posts: 2 Consultant ‘E’ (Pathology), 2 Consultant ‘D’ (Pathology), 4 Consultant ‘D’ / Senior Resident (Critical Care) and 1 Medical Officer ‘D’ (Radiation Oncology), all on project basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for BBCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date of online application is 15 November 2026, up to 05:30 p.m. (Indian Standard Time).

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for BBCI Consultant ‘E’ (Pathology)?
faq.answer: D.M. (Oncopathology) / D.M. (Haematopathology), or M.D. / D.N.B. (Pathology) or equivalent recognized by National Medical Commission with minimum 3 years post M.D. / D.N.B. experience in Pathology.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for BBCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 45 years for Consultant ‘E’ (Pathology) and 40 years for the other three posts, relaxable for experienced and deserving candidates.

faq.question: Q5. Who gets age relaxation in BBCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: TMC employees and employees working in TMC on temporary basis / under project / on contract basis etc. get age relaxation of maximum 5 years; the limit is also relaxable for experienced and deserving candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for BBCI Consultant and Medical Officer posts?
faq.answer: Consultant ‘E’ (Pathology) gets Rs. 1,40,000/- to Rs. 1,52,000/- per month; the other three posts get Rs. 1,28,000/- to Rs. 1,40,000/- per month, consolidated, depending on experience.

faq.question: Q7. How to apply for BBCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply only through the online application link https://tmc.gov.in/fta/frm_Registration.aspx before 05:30 p.m. on 15 November 2026, with a valid email ID.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for BBCI project posts?
faq.answer: Applications are screened and eligible candidates are called for Interview / Written examination; the shortlist for the MCQ / Skill Test / VIVA will be uploaded on the BBCI official website.

faq.question: Q9. Is the BBCI job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The post is temporary and purely contractual, initially for six months, may be extended on satisfactory performance, and is co-terminus with the project.

faq.question: Q10. Will BBCI pay TA/DA or provide accommodation for the interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview, and accommodation will not be provided to outstation candidates.
